title: Alignment Services & Plans Limited Readjustment Guarantee and Adjustment Parts Terms
content:
Every alignment performed under Alignment Services & Plans carries a readjustment guarantee, and adjustment parts installed with an alignment carry their own parts warranty. The terms differ by line as set out below.

## 1. Readjustment guarantee

| Line | Guarantee period, calendar months after the alignment | Guarantee mileage, miles after the alignment's odometer | What must be shown | Causes that void the guarantee |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | 6 | 6000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; suspension modification; worn part failure |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | 6 | 6000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; suspension modification; worn part failure |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; suspension modification; worn part failure |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; suspension modification; worn part failure |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | 6 | 6000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; suspension modification; worn part failure |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | 12 | 12000 | the vehicle measures out of the OEM specification | collision; curb or pothole impact damage; worn part failure |

On the Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance a suspension modification is not among the causes that void the guarantee.

## 2. Specification the alignment is set to

| Line | Specification |
|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment, Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment, Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan, Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan, Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | OEM specifications |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | OEM specifications or the aftermarket kit's specifications |

## 3. Adjustment parts

| Line | Adjustment parts included in the price | Parts charged separately when the vehicle needs them | Parts warranty, calendar months | Parts warranty, miles |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| Crestline Two-Wheel Alignment | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline Four-Wheel Alignment | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline 1-Year Alignment Plan | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline 3-Year Alignment Plan | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |
| Crestline Lifetime Alignment Plan Truck & Performance | No | shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves, eccentric bushings | 12 | 12000 |

## Questions on these terms

**Is a cam bolt kit part of the alignment price on any line?** No. On every line adjustment parts are not included in the price; shims, cam bolt kits, adjustment sleeves and eccentric bushings are charged separately when the vehicle needs them.

**Does a curb strike keep the readjustment guarantee?** No. Curb or pothole impact damage voids the guarantee on every line.

**Hypothetical:** on a line with a 6-month, 6000-mile guarantee, an alignment followed by 6001 miles of driving is past the guarantee mileage even when only a few weeks have passed; whichever limit is reached first ends the guarantee.
